faqs.q: Do you provide onsite IT support?
faqs.a: Yes. Onsite support can be arranged where physical access, installation, maintenance or infrastructure work is required, subject to the agreed service arrangement.
Yes. Remote support can be used for appropriate user, software and system issues, while onsite support can be arranged where physical access is required.

faqs.q: Do you supply computers and networking equipment?
faqs.a: Yes. IT hardware and procurement are part of the MKBIM service offering, including computers, servers, peripherals and networking equipment.

faqs.q: Do you provide server and network services?
faqs.a: Yes. MKBIM supports server and network environments, including Windows and Linux systems, LAN/Wi-Fi, switches, routers and related infrastructure.

faqs.q: Can you support SAP Business One and other business systems?
faqs.a: MKBIM can support business technology environments involving ERP-related systems, databases, infrastructure and user enablement. Requirements are assessed before engagement.

faqs.q: How do I request IT support or a quotation?
faqs.a: Use Request a Quote or Request IT Support, or contact MKBIM through WhatsApp, email or phone. Include a short description of the requirement so the appropriate next step can be discussed.
